LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 1.3.1 WORD CLASSES: DETERMINERS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners, part of Strand 1 in Grade 4 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: How are articles used with nouns?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read aloud the articles a, an and the with peers,

2. identify definite and indefinite articles (a, an, and the) from a paragraph,

3. collaborate to match definite and indefinite articles with a list of nouns,

4. complete blanks in sentences using correct articles,

5. construct sentences with peers using definite and indefinite articles,

6. type sentences on a digital device and share with friends or family via mobile phone, email, computer printouts, among others,

7. view a video related to the theme in

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read aloud the articles a, an and the with peers,
2. identify definite and indefinite articles (a, an, and the) from a paragraph,
3. collaborate to match definite and indefinite articles with a list of nouns,
4. complete blanks in sentences using correct articles,
5. construct sentences with peers using definite and indefinite articles,
6. type sentences on a digital device and share with friends or family via mobile phone, email, computer printouts, among others,
7. view a video related to the theme in

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in use 1.3.1 Word Classes: Determiners together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: This is developed as the learner creates sentences containing articles and shares the content via

digital device.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: This is promoted as the learner completes blanks in sentences using correct articles.

Values:
● Tolerance: This is developed as the learner is able to accommodate diverse views from peers when searching for sentences with

articles from a selected newspaper, magazine or internet.

● Love: It is cultivated as the learner is able to show empathy and take initiative to assist others as they use technology to share their

work.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Digital Safety: This is promoted as the learner observes discipline and cyber safety as they share their work through mobile phones,

emails or online platforms.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of definite and indefinite articles to their learning of similar concepts in Foreign Langauges.
